subject: Initiate vendor questionnaire — SOC2 & data residency clarifications
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medsyte.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@medsyte.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up + questionnaire kickoff: SOC 2, HIPAA/GDPR, and data residency

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a clear path for the security review: 

Summary of what we heard:
- You plan to pilot Redwood for anonymized clinical summarization (no PHI in initial phase).
- Long-term roadmap may include limited PHI ingestion for secure routing and clinician-facing notes.
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 status, data residency (US-only), and evidence for access controls & audit logs.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm which questionnaire you prefer: SIG Lite (faster) or CAIQ/Full SIG (more granular). If you have a custom form, please attach it — we can prefill.
2) MedSyte to confirm whether the pilot counts as a production workload (affects evidence timeline).
3) I'll attach a short SOC 2 summary and our suggested scope spreadsheet for your intake team to map owners.

Clarifying questions for your security/IT reviewer (so we can prepare the right artifacts):
- For data residency, do you require regional isolation (e.g., single-region VPC) or just contractual residency guarantees?
- For PHI: will you need a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) during pilot or only for full production?
- Which evidence cadence works for you: snapshot (one-time) or continued access to our compliance portal (read-only)?

Attachments: MedSyte_SIG_scope-v1.xlsx (template to indicate preferred questionnaire fields), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (high-level doc).

I'll aim to get the SIG prefill (if you pick SIG) and a short evidence pack for the items above by EOD tomorrow. If you'd prefer a quick follow-up call with our security engineer, we can schedule 30 minutes.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medsyte.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@medsyte.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + questionnaire kickoff: SOC 2, HIPAA/GDPR, and data residency

Thanks Mina — this is great and aligned with what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- We'd like Redwood to start with the SIG Lite so we can move faster; if red flags emerge we'll expand to full SIG.
- Pilot is considered non-production for the first 90 days, but we will need a BAA before any PHI processing.
- Data residency: contractual commitment to US-only residency is sufficient for now; no single-region VPC requirement at pilot stage.

Please go ahead with a SIG Lite prefill. Priya and I will route the template to our security intake team — they'll likely ask for the SOC 2 Type II report and a brief summary of encryption at rest and in transit. Can you confirm the earliest you can share SOC 2 artifacts and whether we can get a read-only link to your compliance portal?

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Chen
Director of IT Security | MedSyte Health
alex.chen@medsyte.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@medsyte.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@medsyte.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + questionnaire kickoff: SOC 2, HIPAA/GDPR, and data residency

Mina / Alex — adding a couple of technical clarifications so we scope evidence correctly: 

1) SOC 2 artifacts: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a one-page controls mapping today. Full unredacted report requires an executed NDA/portal access agreement; we can include instructions in the portal invite.

2) Encryption: details we'll include in the prefill: AES-256 at rest (KMS-backed), TLS 1.2+ in transit, and per-customer key support for Dedicated/Private deployments.

3) Audit logs & access controls: we will map required log types (authn, authz changes, admin actions, data export) and indicate retention windows. For pilot we'll include exports.

4) SIG Lite vs Full: SIG Lite answers most high-level questions but we recommend adding 6-8 custom fields around PHI processing and BAA workflows — I'll flag those in the prefill.

Mina — I'll draft the SIG Lite prefill and a short evidence checklist. Alex / Priya — is there a preferred SSO provider or IdP we should reference (Okta, Azure AD, other)? That affects how we document SAML/OIDC evidence.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medsyte.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@medsyte.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up + questionnaire kickoff: SOC 2, HIPAA/GDPR, and data residency

Thanks all — quick status update and next steps: 

- Attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (one-pager) and the MedSyte_SIG_scope-v1.xlsx filled with initial preferences (SIG Lite + 6 custom PHI fields).
- We can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II today. I'll send a secure read-only portal invite (link in HubSpot) once Alex confirms preferred email for portal access.
- Karthik will include the PHI-specific evidence checklist and a sample BAA draft by tomorrow morning.

Action items:
- Alex / Priya: confirm portal access email and whether your intake team needs evidence delivered to a ticketing system (Jira/ServiceNow) or via Drive link.
- Priya: if you prefer a quick 30-minute call with Karthik to walk through the SIG Lite prefill, propose two slots and we'll schedule.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we want this to be low friction.

Best,
Mina Haddad
